title: Scale out: a new worker joins the pool with no manual step
goal: Adding one entry to the OpenTofu node map is the only decision: the machine is created, admitted by the autosign policy with the role from its request, configured by Puppet, and takes jobs.

steps.title: Baseline: a pool of two workers
steps.why: The slots the central manager sees before the change.

command.run: condor_status -af Machine State Cpus; echo; /opt/puppetlabs/bin/puppetserver ca list --all | grep -c '^ *wn-' | sed 's/^/signed workers: /'
command.stdout:
wn-01 Unclaimed 0
wn-01 Claimed 1
wn-01 Claimed 1
wn-02 Unclaimed 0
wn-02 Claimed 1
wn-02 Claimed 1

signed workers: 2

steps.title: The only change: one more entry in the node map
steps.why: The fleet is data, not code. wn-03 is the same kind of node as the other workers.

steps.title: Plan: exactly one machine is added
steps.why: OpenTofu compares the data with what exists: nothing else changes.

command.run: cd tofu && tofu plan -no-color -var-file=/tmp/scale-out.tfvars | grep -E 'will be (created|updated|destroyed)|Plan:'
command.stdout:
# aws_instance.node["wn-03"] will be created
Plan: 2 to add, 0 to change, 1 to destroy.

steps.title: Apply: the machine is created and the inventory regenerated
steps.why: The Ansible inventory is generated from the instances, so wn-03 appears in it automatically.

command.run: cd tofu && tofu apply -no-color -auto-approve -var-file=/tmp/scale-out.tfvars | grep -E 'Creating\.\.\.|Creation complete|Apply complete'
command.stdout:
aws_instance.node["wn-03"]: Creating...
aws_instance.node["wn-03"]: Creation complete after 13s [id=i-0f9c15f22299779f5]
local_file.inventory: Creating...
local_file.inventory: Creation complete after 0s [id=e8ccd86b7ef5b967b476cf618fe84c3b3b4da0fb]
Apply complete! Resources: 2 added, 0 changed, 1 destroyed.

steps.title: Wait until the machine accepts SSH
steps.why: A fresh EC2 instance needs a short time to boot. The check is repeated until Ansible reaches the node.

wait_until.run: cd ansible && ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$PWD/ansible.cfg ansible wn-03 -m ping >/dev/null 2>&1

after_wait.run: cd ansible && ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$PWD/ansible.cfg ansible wn-03 -m ping | grep -E 'SUCCESS|pong'

steps.title: Bootstrap only the new node
steps.why: Ansible installs the agent and sends the certificate request carrying the role and the challenge password. From here on, nothing is configured by hand.

command.run: cd ansible && ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$PWD/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook site.yml --limit wn-03 | grep -E 'PLAY RECAP|^wn-03 +:'
command.stderr: [WARNING]: Module remote_tmp /root/.ansible/tmp did not exist and was created with a mode of 0700, this may cause issues when running as another user. To avoid this, create the remote_tmp dir with the correct permissions manually

steps.title: The node joins the pool by itself
steps.why: Behind the scenes: the autosign policy signs the request, Puppet compiles the catalog for the role, installs and configures HTCondor, and the startd registers at the collector.

after_wait.stdout:
wn-01 Unclaimed 2 true
wn-02 Unclaimed 2 true
wn-03 Unclaimed 2 true

steps.title: Its certificate carries the role, signed automatically
steps.why: wn-03 was admitted by the policy script, and its role is written in the certificate.

command.run: /opt/puppetlabs/bin/puppetserver ca list --all | grep -E '^ *wn-03' | cut -c1-30; openssl x509 -in /etc/puppetlabs/puppet/ssl/ca/signed/wn-03.pem -noout -text | grep -A1 '1.3.6.1.4.1.34380.1.1.13' | tail -1 | tr -d ' .' | sed 's/^/pp_role in the certificate: /'
command.stdout:
wn-03       (SHA256)  89:0
pp_role in the certificate: execute

steps.title: Jobs run on the new node
steps.why: The proof that wn-03 is a full member of the pool.

command.stdout:
Submitting job(s)........
8 job(s) submitted to cluster 7.
